params.body:
The Insights page shows a semiotic read that is stored as one paragraph.

`plain-edit` (pipeline #219) writes the semiotic read of an edited trend as prose instead of `{denotation, connotation, myth}`. The page only looked for those three keys, so for an edited trend it would have shown nothing. A string now renders as one paragraph, "The semiotic read". The three columns stay for everything that still has layers.

Needs to be live before `plain-edit --apply` runs on the public set.

Checks: the lint ratchet is at its ceiling (42), the build passes, and all 23 Playwright tests pass.
params.title: Insights shows a semiotic read stored as one paragraph
